Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description: A privacy policy scan result stored per-user.

uid.description: Firebase UID of the user who ran the scan.

pillars.description: Per-pillar breakdown. null for Quick scans; object for Deep scans.

model.description: NIM model ID used for the scan (e.g. meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct).

cached.description: true if the result was served from L2 Firestore cache.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the scan was created.

User.title: User
User.description: User profile with monthly credit tracking.

credits.description: Remaining scan credits (resets to 400 on the 1st of each month).

lastResetMonth.description: Last reset month in YYYY-MM format.

role.description: User role. Currently only 'admin' is used.

SharedCache.title: SharedCache
SharedCache.description: Anonymous cross-user result cache. Written by Admin SDK only — client access is blocked by Firestore rules.

result.description: Full scan result payload (same shape as Scan minus uid).

scannedAt.description: When the original scan was run.

expiresAt.description: Cache expiry: 48h for Quick, 7d for Deep.

scanCount.description: Number of times this cached result has been served.

sourceUrlHash.description: SHA-256 of the source URL (for lookup without exposing full URL).

Report.title: Report
Report.description: User-submitted feedback on an incorrect scan result.

url.description: URL of the scanned page being reported.

rating.description: The rating the user believes is wrong.

score.description: The score the user believes is wrong.

pillars.description: Pillar breakdown from the disputed scan.

requestId.description: X-Request-ID from the original analysis response.

/scans/{scanId}.description: Per-user scan history. Document ID is auto-generated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile and credit balance. Document ID is the Firebase UID.

/shared_cache/{hash}.description: Anonymous cross-user result cache. Document ID is SHA-256(text + tier + eli5 + darkPatterns + modelId). Client-read-blocked.

/reports/{reportId}.description: User feedback on incorrect results. Document ID is auto-generated.
